title: A Hazard Analysis Framework for Code Synthesis Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Red teaming and prompting the model to generate code for classification tasks to observe if it encodes biased assumptions, such as defaulting to binary gender representations.
Red teaming code generation prompts involving the classification of physical or mental attributes to identify if the model produces outputs that exacerbate false and harmful stereotypes.
Red teaming code generation prompts involving demographic classification to identify if the model produces outputs that exacerbate racist or harmful stereotypes.
Red teaming code generation prompts involving the classification of nationality to identify if the model produces biased assumptions or harmful stereotypes.
Red teaming code generation prompts involving the classification of socio-economic status to identify if the model produces outputs that exacerbate false and harmful stereotypes.
